bullets: Added a security check for new accounts on virtual or cloud networks, replacing a hard refusal with a waiting step on the login page.
Opened the community feed to every signed-in account, replacing the previous rule that restricted it to project publishers or admins.
Added support for pausing paid desktop hours, which banks unused time for later use after deducting a 15-minute context reload cost.
Updated the terminal daily usage meter to count down a running paid hour in real time instead of deducting the full cost at session start.
Added a specific explanation for sites blocked from publishing due to content violations, relaying the server's reason to the user.
Added support for distinguishing a specific product from an advertiser company name in sponsored skill campaigns.
Added a mechanism to save task progress when a paid computer hour ends while the device is disconnected, allowing users to resume later.
Added a signal that allows new chats to start on the Powerful tier instead of falling back to Balanced when another chat holds an active hour.
